_comment: Hand corrections applied after scripts/auto_recipes.py by scripts/fix_labels.py. Sources are libretro-thumbnails paths. art.window is the visible 39:16 art window in source pixels (left, top, right, bottom); it is widened or narrowed vertically to the exact aspect around its centre. logo.method builds a transparent logo where upstream has none or the wrong one; see fix_labels.py for each method.

fixes.title: Conker's Bad Fur Day
fixes.reason: No upstream logo; the label was a small boxed title screen on black. Logo rebuilt from the title screen, BAD FUR DAY set on one line under the Conker's script; art is Conker with his beer from the box.

fixes.title: Diddy Kong Racing
fixes.reason: Automatic crop showed only Diddy's belly and the kart nose. Window moved up to his face, with Pipsy fading in behind the title.

fixes.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater
fixes.reason: Automatic crop showed hands and a board with no skater. Window moved to Tony mid-air from the top of the box.

fixes.title: FIFA - Road to World Cup 98
fixes.reason: No upstream logo; the label was a blurry title screen with no art. Logo keyed from the box (black ink on white); art is the player from the box.

fixes.title: Pokemon Puzzle League
fixes.reason: No upstream logo; the label was a boxed title screen on grey. Logo cut from the box; art is Bulbasaur, Pikachu and Squirtle.

fixes.title: Pokemon Stadium
fixes.reason: No upstream logo; the label was a title-screen strip with no fade. Logo cut from the box; art is Charizard and Blastoise.

fixes.title: Snowboard Kids
fixes.reason: No upstream logo; the label was a boxed title screen on black. Logo keyed off the title-screen sky; art is the box characters.

fixes.title: NHL Breakaway 99
fixes.reason: Upstream 'NHL Breakaway 99 (USA)' logo is a symlink to the 98 logo, so the label said 98. Uses the real 99 logo (Europe file) and Yzerman from the box instead of a gameplay snap.

fixes.title: Monster Truck Madness 64
fixes.reason: Dark 'Madness 64' disappeared on the near-black background. Background is the box's grey and art is the truck.

fixes.title: Castlevania
fixes.reason: Crop repeated part of the box title. Window moved down to Reinhardt and the castle.

fixes.title: Excitebike 64
fixes.reason: Crop was mostly sponsor logos. Window moved to the bike.

fixes.title: Namco Museum 64
fixes.reason: Art was the box's game list (text). Window moved to Pac-Man.

fixes.title: Turok - Rage Wars
fixes.reason: Gameplay snap printed 'ASSAULT RIFLE' HUD text. Uses the box creature above the title instead.

fixes.title: FIFA - Road to World Cup 98 - World Cup e no Michi
fixes.reason: No upstream logo; the label was a blurry title screen with no art. Logo keyed from the Japanese box (blue ink on white); art is the box flames.
